import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'library.db'
INDEXER_URL = 'http://search-indexer.internal.example.com/api/photos/moved'


def _notify_indexer(photo_id: int, old_path: str, new_path: str, captured_at: str) -> None:
    payload = json.dumps({'photo_id': photo_id, 'old_path': old_path, 'new_path': new_path, 'captured_at': captured_at}).encode('utf-8')
    req = urllib.request.Request(INDEXER_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        pass


@function_tool
def organize_photo_into_dated_folder(photo_id: int, library_root: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT file_path, captured_at FROM photos WHERE id = ?', (photo_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return f'Photo {photo_id} not found'
    current_path = Path(row[0])
    captured_at = row[1]
    year = captured_at[0:4]
    month = captured_at[5:7]
    target_dir = Path(library_root) / year / month
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    new_path = target_dir / current_path.name
    shutil.move(str(current_path), str(new_path))
    conn.execute('UPDATE photos SET file_path = ? WHERE id = ?', (str(new_path), photo_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    _notify_indexer(photo_id, str(current_path), str(new_path), captured_at)
    return f'Moved photo {photo_id} to {new_path}'
